  1 ≤ n ∧ 1 ≤ m →
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (Function.uncurry u) (timeDomain n) →
      ((∀ (t0 : ℝ),
            0 < t0 →
              ∃ C R,
                IsCompact C ∧
                  0 < R ∧
                    C ⊆ openBox R ∧
                      (∀ (x : Space n) (r : ℝ), x ∉ C → r ∈ Set.Icc (t0 / 2) (3 * t0 / 2) → u x r = q) ∧
                        volume (box R) = ENNReal.ofReal ((2 * R) ^ n) ∧
                          volume (box R) < ⊤ ∧
                            (∀ (k : ℕ) (x : Space n) (r : ℝ),
                                0 < k →
                                  x ∉ C →
                                    r ∈ Set.Ioo (t0 / 2) (3 * t0 / 2) →
                                      iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (Function.uncurry u) (x, r) = 0) ∧
                              ∀ r ∈ Set.Ioo (t0 / 2) (3 * t0 / 2),
                                sectionGood (fun x => density u x r) C R ∧
                                  sectionGood (fun x => densityT u x r) C R ∧
                                    sectionGood (fun x => inner ℝ (dt u x r) (dtt u x r)) C R ∧
                                      ∀ (j : Fin n),
                                        sectionGood (flux u j r) C R ∧
                                          sectionGood (fun x => inner ℝ (dut u j x r) (du u j x r)) C R ∧
                                            sectionGood (fun x => inner ℝ (dt u x r) (duu u j x r)) C R ∧
                                              sectionGood (fun x => dx (flux u j r) j x) C R) ∧
          ∀ (t : ℝ), 0 < t → Integrable (fun x => density u x t) volume) →
        (∀ (j : Fin n),
            ∃ e,
              (∀ (x : Space n), e x = (WithLp.toLp 2 fun i => x.ofLp ↑i, x.ofLp j)) ∧
                MeasurePreserving (⇑e) volume (volume.prod volume)) →
          ∀ (t : ℝ),
            0 < t →
